generatedFrom.note: Source refs are path:line at this SHA. The status indicator section cites 9e5083e7554 (reworked after the screenshot build). Colors are formulas over the terminal theme; the resolved tables under themes.* are computed by tools/derive_theme_tokens.py, a line-for-line port of ThemeTokens.derive, and spot-checked against screenshots.

conventions.units: pt = macOS points (1 CSS px at devicePixelRatio 1; screenshots are 2x). Times in seconds.
conventions.colorRefs: token:<name> is a ThemeTokens field. alpha(token:x, a) replaces alpha. mix(a, b, t) = a + (b-a)*t per sRGB channel (ThemeRGB.mixed). over(fill, surface) = source-over compositing.
conventions.density: Every metric has compact and comfortable values. Default density is compact (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/DesignSettings.swift:25). appearance.density in cmux.json switches it.
conventions.pixelSnapping: Strip and pill offsets snap to device pixels: snap(v)=round(v*scale)/scale, snapDown(v)=floor(v*scale+0.0001)/scale (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextDesign/PaneChromeMetrics.swift:69-77). Hairlines are 1/scale pt (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextLayout/Geometry/PaneChromeGeometry.swift:62).
conventions.noBlue: No accent hue. Selection, hover and focus are the theme foreground at low alpha. The only blue that can appear is token:highlight (the theme ANSI blue), used solely by the agent composer Send button (Packages/Shared/CmuxTheme/Sources/CmuxTheme/ThemeTokens.swift:72).

input.description: ThemeInput: background, foreground, ANSI palette 0-15, selection-background/foreground (only when the config names a color), background-opacity (0-1), background-blur (0 off, >0 radius, <0 macOS glass). Read from the Ghostty config; cmux appearance.theme overrides theme = after the config files.

defaultTheme.value: light:Apple System Colors Light,dark:Apple System Colors

input.lightDark: isDark = luminance(background) < luminance(foreground) (Packages/Shared/CmuxTheme/Sources/CmuxTheme/ThemeTokens.swift:104). The app light/dark appearance picks the light: or dark: half of the theme spec.

textPrimary.value: readable(fg, over(pressedFill,bg), 4.5): fg pushed toward white (surface lum<0.18) or black in 0.02 steps until 4.5:1

textSecondary.value: muted(textPrimary toward bg, up to 0.38, keeping 4.5:1 over over(pressedFill,bg)); steps of 0.01

textTertiary.value: muted(textPrimary toward bg, up to 0.55, keeping 3:1)

separator.value: alpha(fg, dark ? 0.08 : 0.07); clear when appearance.borders = none

paneBorder.value: alpha(fg, dark ? 0.07 : 0.09); clear when appearance.borders = none

focusRing.value: alpha(fg, 0.40). The pane ring replaces the alpha with focusRing.contrast (see components.panes.focusRing)

textSelection.value: selection-background if set, else mix(bg, fg, 0.22)

highlightText.value: bg or textPrimary (opaque), whichever contrasts more with highlight, if >= 4.5; else black or white

pageBackground.value: opaque contentBackground (browser page before first paint, error pages)

scopes.description: ThemeScope: app (Ghostty config), room, workspace and terminal themes. A view applies tokens of its own scope inside performWithTheme; a pane's chrome takes the terminal theme it shows. Tokens outside a scope are dynamic app-theme colors.

windowBackdrop.description: background-opacity < 1 and blur >= 0: window is translucent, CGS blur radius applied, panes do not paint their own background. background-blur < 0: macOS glass style. Opaque otherwise.

appleSystemDark.name: Apple System Colors (cmux default, dark appearance)

appleSystemLight.name: Apple System Colors Light (cmux default, light appearance)

ghosttyDefault.name: Ghostty built-in default (ThemeInput.ghosttyDefault, used until the config is read)

typography.family: SF Pro (NSFont.systemFont); monospaced chips use SF Mono (monospacedSystemFont). Web ports: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text' / ui-monospace, 'SF Mono'.
typography.lineHeight: AppKit default line height for the font (no explicit line spacing in chrome). SF Pro 12pt ~ 15pt, 13pt ~ 16pt (ascender+descender+leading of NSFont). Ports must measure, not assume CSS normal.

metrics.corners: All rounded rects use cornerCurve = continuous (squircle). Web ports: use a superellipse path or accept the circular-arc delta in the diff budget.

overlay.select: Reduce Transparency -> opaque; macOS >= 26 -> liquidGlass (NSGlassEffectView .regular, tint token:glassTint); else vibrancy (NSVisualEffectView .popover, withinWindow, tint view token:glassTint, 1/scale border token:separator)

opaqueFallback.value: mix(opaque windowBackground, opaque textPrimary, 0.14) with 1/scale border opaque separator

stripBackdrop.value: ChromeBackdropView material .headerView with the strip tint; hidden unless tabBarBackground=darker or the pane theme differs from the window

move.use: Tab reflow and reorder, sidebar row moves, pane and divider frames

appear.use: Palette scale-in, tab grow-in, group expand, row insert, sidebar show

disappear.use: Tab close, group collapse, row removal, sidebar hide

scroll.use: Strip reveal, column reveal, fling snap

track.use: Drop-zone overlay and drag ghost between targets

springModel.value: omega = 2*pi/response; stiffness = omega^2; damping = 2*dampingFraction*omega; semi-implicit Euler at 1/480 s (SwiftUI .spring(response:dampingFraction:) equivalent)

hover.use: Hover fills, hover-revealed buttons, divider hover

focus.use: Pane focus ring and inactive dim

fadeIn.use: Palette, find bar, notices, hover card appear

fadeOut.use: Palette close, find bar, notices, hover card hide

crossfade.use: Hover card thumbnail swap; Reduce Motion ceiling

reduceMotion.value: No movement springs, no loops; fades capped at crossfade (0.1 s). Speed off disables fades too.

value.effect: none clears every border, hairline and separator, disables the focus ring and attention width; focusIndicator=border then falls back to inactive dim

value.note: Debug Settings tunable only (no cmux.json key yet)
Debug Settings tunable only (no cmux.json key yet)

sidebar.workspaceRow.description: A workspace row in the sidebar list. Text-first, fills only, no borders.

titleFade.value: space6 (16) edge fade on clipped titles

hover.closeButton: shown, replaces badge; title narrows then marquees
hover.marquee: starts after motion.marquee.delay (not under Reduce Motion)

background.value: token:selectionFill on a shared pill that glides between rows (spring selection)

gap.value: token:hoverFill gap pill at the insertion point

states.pressed: no distinct state (selection changes on mouse down)
states.focused(keyboard): no ring; keyboard selection moves the pill

shadow.value: token:shadow, opacity 0.28 lifted, radius space5 (12), offset y space3 (6); resting opacity 0 radius space2 offset space1

stack.value: back cards alpha(elevatedBackground,0.85) inset space2*depth, 0.5pt border token:separator

states.unfocusedWindow: no change (only the system traffic lights dim)

sidebar.statusIndicator.description: Shared status indicator for rows and tabs (@9e5083e: arc, native spinner, dot, ring, check). At the screenshot SHA the sidebar used ActivityIndicatorView (running arc 0.72, stroke space1*0.75, needsInput dot attention, error dot danger, pulse low 0.35).

states.busy: arc spinning (loop.spinner 0.9 s) in token:textSecondary (or appearance.statusIndicator.color); with progress a ring over a 0.22 track
states.reduceMotion: no spin or pulse; static glyphs

chevron.value: token:textTertiary, SF Symbol pt smallIconSize-space2 bold

sidebar.sectionItem.description: Sticky section items (Home, Settings, Account) in each section look.

icon.value: token:textSecondary (token:textOnPrimary on a colored list chip)

fill.value: none; tray tile: token:hoverFill at rest

sidebar.sections.look.card: headers, sections on cards filled token:hoverFill, no lines
sidebar.sections.look.tray: headers, built-in items as a grid of tiles on token:hoverFill, no lines
sidebar.sections.look.lines: no headers, a line between sections
sidebar.sections.look.linesIcons: no headers, lines, built-in items as icon-only buttons

tabs.strip.description: Every pane has a tab strip. Strip edges are the content border edges.

metrics.height: tabStripHeight (28/36); resolved = pillTop + tabHeight + tabGap with pane padding

states.hover: trailing buttons reveal while the pointer is in the strip (TabStripButtonReveal)

appearance.tabBarBackground.window: strip = window background, no fill layer

default(unselected).icon: tinted like the title; dormant opacity 0.55

states.pressed: no distinct tab fill (selection on mouse down)

fill.value: token:separator, height tabHeight/2, centered in the gap, shown between unselected neighbours

shadow.value: token:shadow opacity 0.22, radius space3, offset y space1

tabs.inactivePaneEmphasis.description: How an unfocused pane's tabs draw subtler when focusIndicator marks tabs and the screen has >1 pane.

focus.inactiveTabStyle.fade: text tiers mixed toward the page by strength until contrast floors; selectionFill and hoverFill alpha *(1-strength)
focus.inactiveTabStyle.tonal: primary<-secondary, secondary<-tertiary, tertiary faded strength/2; selectionFill = hoverFill alpha *(1-strength/2)
focus.inactiveTabStyle.quiet: primary<-secondary, secondary/tertiary faded strength/2; selectionFill transparent

metrics.thumbnail: tabMaxWidth x round(tabMaxWidth*10/16), radius itemCornerRadius, placeholder token:hoverFill

metrics.offset: space2 below or beside the anchor, space2 screen margin

overlays.hoverCardPanel.material: Glass panel, tint token:glassTint (overlay material fallbacks apply)

border.value: token:paneBorder hairline, shown when no ring/attention draws

dim.value: opaque token:contentBackground at opacity 0.14, only when dimsInactivePanes or (borders none and focusIndicator border)

ring.value: token:attention (or notification color), width 2, blink x2 over 3 s, persists

states.shown: focused pane, >1 pane (or showWhenSinglePane), focusIndicator border|both, borders default

color.value: focusRing.color ?? alpha(fg, contrast) where contrast subtle 0.20 / standard 0.55 / strong 0.85

metrics.keycap: iconSize+space2 square min, radius itemCornerRadius-space1, gap space1

typography.title: body (matched chars bodyEmphasized textPrimary; others alpha(textPrimary,0.78) while filtering)
typography.subtitle: caption textSecondary

panel.rules: token:separator above and below the list

shadow.value: alpha(token:shadow,0.22), blur space6+space4 (24), offset y space4 (8)

typography.url: compact URL: host token:textPrimary, rest token:textSecondary
